_comment: ignoreCommand decides whether Vercel builds at all: exit 0 skips, exit 1 builds.
It used to read `[ "$VERCEL_ENV" != "production" ]`, which skips whenever
VERCEL_ENV is anything other than the exact string 'production' — including
empty. A skip is silent and looks identical to a build that never started, so
the rule now fails towards deploying: only a confirmed preview is skipped, and
anything unrecognised builds. The echo puts the decision inputs in the build
log, so 'why did production not update' is answerable from the log itself.
ignoreCommand: echo "ignore-step: VERCEL_ENV=$VERCEL_ENV ref=$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF sha=$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA"; if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ]; then echo 'preview — skipping build'; exit 0; fi; echo 'not a preview — building'; exit 1
